# AdChefs

> Dedicated video editors for e-commerce brands doing over €5k/month in ad spend. Pay per delivered video. No retainers, no rotating freelancers.

AdChefs places one trained direct-response editor inside each brand, managed by a founder with 10 years editing for revenue and 7 in DR video. Max 2–3 brands per month.

- [Home](/): How AdChefs works, pricing, booking, and FAQ.
- [About](/about): Founder story — Jonas Bjørnerud, why AdChefs exists.
